learning_outcomes.text: To become familiar with modern mechanical processing technologies and technical means.
To identify the main categories of engineering materials.
To know and interpret technical documentation.

syllabus_topics: Activities specific to the company/department/workshop/laboratory where the practical activity takes place
Elements of CAD/CAM/CAE modeling of mechanical systems
Methods for manufacturing technical parts, measurement and control systems used in design and manufacturing technological processes, manufacturing systems

assessment_methods.method: Verification of knowledge acquired during the practical stage

assessment_rules: The final grade takes into account questions related to the practical notebook content and the activity during the practice. Verification of acquired knowledge accounts for 50%, and the practical notebook for 50%. To pass the discipline, a minimum of 50% knowledge volume is required, and the practical notebook must be completed.
